title: Transformers
tagline: Your car might be a robot. Eat anyway.
about: A teenager's first car turns out to be an alien robot, and he ends up in the middle of a war between Autobots and Decepticons.
cue: Serve the snacks when the Autobots try to hide in Sam's backyard.

Autobots, roll out!How to make it300g corn chips250g cooked chicken, shredded1 can black beans200g tasty cheese1 jar tomato salsa150ml sour creamDrain the beans and grate the cheese.Spread the chips on a tray and top with chicken, beans and cheese.Bake at 200°C.Finish with salsa and sour cream.Desert base lamb kofta with garlic yoghurtLennox's team holding out in Qatar.How to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb mince with onion, cumin and parsley shaped onto skewers, grilled and served with garlic yoghurt.Mix 600g lamb mince with 1 grated onion squeezed dry, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, half a teaspoon cinnamon, chopped parsley and salt.Shape around 8 skewers into long sausages and chill 20 minutes.Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred.Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and mint.Serve with warm flatbread and sliced tomato.Chicken quesadillas with salsaPaid for with ladiesman217's eBay money.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRon's backyard ribsPork ribs rubbed with paprika, baked in foil, then charred with barbecue sauceHow to make it1.5kg pork ribs2 tbsp smoked paprika100g brown sugar1 tbsp salt100ml barbecue sauce1/2 small cabbage2 carrots3 tbsp mayonnaiseRub the ribs with paprika, sugar and salt and wrap in foil.Bake at 150°C.Brush with barbecue sauce and char over hot coals.Shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and toss with mayonnaise for coleslaw.Hoover Dam beef chilli and cornbreadNo sacrifice, no victory. Old Witwicky motto.How to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, with sour cream and cornbread.Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches.Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder.Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours.Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.Serve with sour cream.SweetsAllSpark cube browniesFudgy brownie cubes.
